Links

A collection of websites I like.

  • Languagehat

    languagehat.com

    A blog about languages run by a retired copyeditor.

  • Handbook of Finnish

    jkorpela.fi/finnish/index.html

    A freely-available highly detailed Finnish grammar. It came useful to me in writing my Bachelors’ thesis.

  • Medžuslovjansky Jezyk – Меджусловјанскы језык – Interslavic

    steen.free.fr/interslavic/index.html

    The main website of the Interslavic project. Interslavic is a constructed language whose goal is to be easily understood and learnt by people who speak various Slavic languages. If you already speak a Slavic language, try to understand the first sentence on the website, written entirely in Interslavic: “Medžuslovjansky jest jezyk, ktory Slovjani raznyh narodnostij koristajut, da by komunikovali jedin s drugym.”

  • Searchable Index Diachronica

    chridd.nfshost.com/diachronica/

    A searchable version of the massive Index Diachronica, a document containing a comprehensive list of diachronic sound changes.

  • The North Wind and the Sun Database

    datashare.ed.ac.uk/handle/10283/387

    A database of recordings of Aesop’s The North Wind and the Sun fable realised in the 1950’s and 1960’s in a variety of world languages.

  • Dizionario Etimologico

    www.etimo.it

    Una versione digitale del Vocabolario etimologico della lingua italiana di Ottorino Pianigiani.

  • Taras Shevchenko’s Poems, Works and Life Story in English

    taras-shevchenko.storinka.org

    A collection of English translations of Ukrainian poet Taras Shevchenko’s works.

  • The Joyce Project

    joyceproject.com

    A meticulously annotated version of James Joyce’s classic novel Ulysses.

  • The Waste Land :: T. S. Eliot

    wasteland.windingway.org

    An annotated online version of T.S. Eliot’s The Waste Land.

  • Werich & Horníček: Předscény

    ufo.fme.vutbr.cz/JWMH/

    Pro mé spřízněné fanoušky Wericha a Horníčka (potažmo Wericha a Voskovce), tato klasická stránka obsahuje přepisy všech jejich forbín.
